fullContentHtml:
IBPS Specialist Officer SO 16th Mains Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released Mains Admit Card for the post of CRP SPL XV 16th Specialist Officer SO. This recruitment was released for 1035 posts. Applications for the IBPS Specialist Officer SO 16th Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 1 July 2026, to 26 July 2026. The mains examination is going to be conducted on 01 November 2026. Candidates who qualified this pre examination can download their IBPS Specialist Officer SO 16th Mains Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Starting Date : 01 July 2026
  • Last Date for Registration : 26 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 July 2026
  • Edit Application Window : : 29-30 July 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 29 August 2026
  • Pre Admit Card : 20 August 2026
  • Pre Result : 15 October 2026
  • Pre Score Card : 21 October 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 1 November 2026
  • Mains Admit Card : 22 October 2026
  • Mains Result : November 2026
  • Interview Letter : November 2026
  • Interview Date : November/ December 2026
  • Final Result : January 2027

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 850/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 175/-
  • PH : Rs. 175/-
  • Application Correction Charge : Rs. 200/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
